# Energy execution review | Wednesday 11 November 2026
**Full UTC day. Fixed audit cutoff: 12 November 2026, 09:20 UTC.** Reopen this notebook to rerun the same session. Automatic refresh is off.
**3,007 valid trades:** 2,757 exchange fills plus 250 corrected broker/OTC trades. Overall 15-minute marked value is **+$1.299m** before fees. This includes favourable market movement and is not realised desk P&L.
Start with the counterparty warning, then the exchange controls, inventory, model, feed and booking panels. Negative markouts mean the market moved against our trade.

WITH h AS (SELECT t.ts,t.trade_id,t.order_id,t.book,t.trader,t.symbol,t.curve,t.venue,t.passive,t.qty,t.px,
h.offset/1000000000 AS sec,(q.bid+q.ask)/2 mid,q.bid,q.ask,(t.ts+h.offset-q.ts)/1000000000.0 age
FROM energy_fills t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol=q.symbol AND t.venue=q.source)
LIST (-30s,0,1s,30s,5m,15m) AS h WHERE t.ts IN @session),
p AS (SELECT ts,trade_id,order_id,book,trader,symbol,curve,venue,passive,qty,px,
max(CASE WHEN sec=-30 THEN mid END) mpre,
max(CASE WHEN sec=0 THEN mid END) m0,
max(CASE WHEN sec=1 THEN mid END) m1,
max(CASE WHEN sec=30 THEN mid END) m30,
max(CASE WHEN sec=300 THEN mid END) m300,
max(CASE WHEN sec=900 THEN mid END) m900,
max(CASE WHEN sec=0 THEN bid END) bid0,
max(CASE WHEN sec=0 THEN ask END) ask0,
max(CASE WHEN sec=0 THEN age END) age0,
max(CASE WHEN sec=300 THEN age END) age300
FROM h), c AS (
 SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts <= @audit
  LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id
 ) WHERE trade_ts IN @session AND status != 'CANCELLED'
), oh AS (SELECT t.trade_id,t.trade_ts,t.booked_ts,t.book,t.trader,t.symbol,t.curve,t.qty,t.px,t.channel,t.counterparty,
h.offset/1000000 sec,q.ts quote_ts,q.bid,q.ask
FROM ((SELECT *, CASE WHEN curve IN ('TTF','EUA') THEN 'ICE_ENDEX' WHEN curve='WTI' THEN 'CME' ELSE 'ICE' END AS ref_source FROM energy_trade_events WHERE version=1 AND channel!='EXCH' AND trade_ts IN @session ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)) t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol=q.symbol AND t.ref_source=q.source)
LIST (-5m,-30s,0,30s,5m,15m,1h) AS h),
op AS (
 SELECT trade_id,
 max(CASE WHEN sec=-300 THEN (bid+ask)/2 END) mpre,
 max(CASE WHEN sec=0 THEN (bid+ask)/2 END) m0,
 max(CASE WHEN sec=30 THEN (bid+ask)/2 END) m30,
 max(CASE WHEN sec=300 THEN (bid+ask)/2 END) m300,
 max(CASE WHEN sec=900 THEN (bid+ask)/2 END) m900,
 max(CASE WHEN sec=3600 THEN (bid+ask)/2 END) m3600,
 max(CASE WHEN sec=0 THEN (cast(trade_ts AS long)*1000-quote_ts::long)/1000000000.0 END) age0,
 max(CASE WHEN sec=900 THEN (cast(trade_ts AS long)*1000+900000000000-quote_ts::long)/1000000000.0 END) age900
 FROM oh
), bm AS (
 SELECT t.symbol,timestamp_floor('1h',t.ts) hour,
 avg((q.close-t.close)/t.close*10000) market_15m_bps
 FROM energy_quotes_1m t HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes_1m q ON (symbol)
 LIST (15m) AS h WHERE t.ts IN @session GROUP BY t.symbol,hour
), o AS (
 SELECT c.*,op.mpre,op.m0,op.m30,op.m300,op.m900,op.m3600,op.age0,op.age900,
 u.factor,
 CASE WHEN c.counterparty LIKE 'PRODUCER_%' THEN 'PRODUCER'
      WHEN c.counterparty LIKE 'UTILITY_%' THEN 'UTILITY'
      WHEN c.counterparty LIKE 'INDUSTRIAL_%' THEN 'INDUSTRIAL'
      WHEN c.counterparty LIKE 'BANK_%' THEN 'BANK' ELSE 'TRADER' END cp_group,
 CASE WHEN c.qty>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE -1.0 END sgn,
 sgn*(op.m900-c.px)/c.px*10000 mo15,
 sgn*((op.m900-op.m0)/c.px*10000-bm.market_15m_bps) adjusted15
 FROM op JOIN c ON op.trade_id=c.trade_id
 LEFT JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON c.symbol=u.symbol
 LEFT JOIN bm ON c.symbol=bm.symbol AND timestamp_floor('1h',c.trade_ts)=bm.hour
 WHERE c.channel!='EXCH'
),
ex AS (SELECT 'Exchange fills' scope,count() trades,sum(abs(qty)*px*u.factor) gross_usd,
sum(qty*(m0-px)*u.factor) mark0_usd,sum(qty*(m300-px)*u.factor) mark5_usd,sum(qty*(m900-px)*u.factor) mark15_usd
FROM p LEFT JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof u ON p.symbol=u.symbol),
ot AS (SELECT 'Restated broker and OTC' scope,count() trades,sum(abs(qty)*px*factor) gross_usd,
sum(qty*(m0-px)*factor) mark0_usd,sum(qty*(m300-px)*factor) mark5_usd,sum(qty*(m900-px)*factor) mark15_usd FROM o)
SELECT * FROM ex UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ot

## Counterparty warning: WTI producer flow
**Five trades, 190,000 bbl, $16.49m gross:** average markout deteriorates from **-1.73 bps at trade time** to **-19.53 bps at 15m** and **-32.23 bps at 1h**. The 15m marked loss is **$29,180**, of which **$26,470** is post-trade deterioration.
**PRODUCER_03 accounts for four trades and $21,430**; PRODUCER_06 accounts for one and $7,750. Trades span buys and sells, four traders, and March-June contracts. Quotes are at most 5.07s old at execution and 3.36s at 15m.
After subtracting same-contract, same-hour average signed 15m market drift, the residual is **-16.39 bps**, naive t = **-4.26**. This is the strongest pickoff candidate, not proof of informed intent. The four producer trades on 10 November had residual **+1.22 bps**, so persistence is unproven.
**Secondary watch:** gasoil industrial broker/OTC flow lost **$48,662.50** on nine trades yesterday; residual **-8.75 bps**, t = **-1.25**. Across 10-11 November: 17 trades, **-$121,225**, residual **-10.40 bps**, naive t = **-2.60**. INDUSTRIAL_08's two broker trades contributed **-$42,187.50** yesterday. Small cells require more sessions.

cells.value:
## Exchange fills: do not confuse spread, market drift and toxicity
**Gasoil:** all 442 fills are aggressive. Initial markout **-1.52 bps** versus **1.49 bps half-spread**, only **0.034 bps beyond the touch**. At 15m, **-1.25 bps / -$35,812.50**, but drift-adjusted post-trade movement is **+0.10 bps**, t = **0.12**. The negative level is mainly spread cost.
**NBP passive:** 138 fills, **-$131,471.80 / -9.37 bps at 15m**, but the hourly market control leaves **+1.43 bps**, t = **0.33**. This does not establish venue-specific adverse selection. The common gas/power repricing around 09:30 is visible beside the markout curve.
**UK power:** ICE aggressive residual **-7.07 bps**, n = 96, t = **-1.21**; EEX passive residual **-7.73 bps**, n = 16, t = **-0.87**. Watch both, without ranking either venue as definitively toxic.
Exchange counterparty fields are clearing houses, not the anonymous opposing traders. These data cannot identify who took the other side of exchange fills.

## Brent: inventory-control exception
Opening inventory plus corrected, uncancelled trading activity gives a **2.931m bbl CRUDE/BRENT peak at 07:29:26 UTC**, **146.55%** of the **listed 2m bbl limit**. Position exceeded that limit from **07:21:49 to 08:28:33**, or **66.73 minutes**. It closed at **406,000 bbl**.
trader_01's Jan-27 exchange flow was 202 fills and **6.283m bbl gross**, with buys totalling 3.503m bbl and sells 2.780m bbl. Its 15m marked value was **+$765,535**. This is an inventory and turnover concern, not evidence of being picked off.
The risk reconstruction includes opening snapshots and all valid exchange/broker/OTC bookings, aggregated before the running sum. Existing fill-only live views and the ledger omit broker/OTC activity; running-day views also omit opening inventory. Limits and master data are the supplied 12 November reference snapshots, not an effective-dated limit history. The path below is restated hindsight, not necessarily what was booked on screen at each instant.

## Problems with valuation, market data and booking
**Model:** after 10:00 UTC, champion_v1 winter monthly marks underprice TTF by **438.73 bps**, NBP by **436.40 bps** and UK power by **365.40 bps** on average. Challenger_v2 winter MAE is roughly **8 bps**; both versions' summer MAE is roughly 8 bps. Inputs are stamped 0.5s before model publication. This is a winter pricing-model issue; no routing/model-version link proves it caused the fills.
**Curve marking:** 30 manual TTF_Q1-27 marks by trader_11 during 08:00-08:29 are **EUR 2.50/MWh above concurrent MARKET version 2** and roughly EUR 2.499/MWh above the delivery-hour-weighted monthly strip. This is a valuation/mark-governance exception, not execution loss. Source and version must both be retained when comparing marks.
**Volatility:** four TTF_Mar-27 ATM observations at 10:30-10:45 have version 2 IV **0.08 higher** than version 1, with unchanged tau. That is an **8 volatility-point correction**, not an 8% execution loss.
**Feed:** EEX Dec-26 TTF and UK power have simultaneous **180s gaps at 08:45-08:48**; primary feeds continue. There are **no EEX fills in those affected contracts during the gap**. The one affected-contract fill is TTF on ICE_ENDEX. This supports a feed-quality incident, not proven missed or bad executions.
**Booking:** by the audit cutoff, **34 prior-session trades arrived after midnight**: 8 broker and 26 OTC, about **$217.85m gross**. The close-time view contains 216 non-exchange trades versus 250 restated. There are also **15 correction/cancellation events**, including a cancelled duplicate and a cancelled error. These are separate from pickoff losses.

## How to read the evidence
- **Execution markout:** sign(qty) x (future mid - fill price) / fill price x 10,000. Positive is favourable. Dollar markout is qty x price difference x price-unit factor x USD FX. These are trade-conditioned marked values, not independent realised profits.
- **Quotes:** exchange fills use their own venue/source. Broker/OTC trades use CME for WTI, ICE_ENDEX for TTF/EUA, and ICE elsewhere. HORIZON JOIN takes the latest quote at or before each target, never a future quote. Quote ages are exposed rather than silently carrying every stale quote as executable. All 2,757 exchange fills have matches at the displayed horizons. Coarser strips have sparse quotes; do not overinterpret their apparent price improvement.
- **Market control:** subtract the same contract's average 15m primary-market return over 1-minute observations in the trade's UTC hour, signed by our side, from post-trade mid-to-mid movement. This controls broad drift; it is not a causal counterfactual or an exact time-matched peer execution. Primary-source materialized views exclude EEX by design.
- **Statistics:** reported bps are trade-weighted means; USD is quantity-weighted. Raw t-statistics use sample standard deviation / sqrt(n). Intraday observations overlap, multiple segments were screened, and small samples are fragile. Strong t-values do not establish informed intent; null t at n=1 is deliberate. The 10 November check uses all available prior-day history, not a selected subset.
- **Lifecycle:** exchange execution panels preserve actual fill records. Broker/OTC panels use trade time, original quote alignment and the latest uncancelled corrected economics known by the fixed audit cutoff. Booking delay uses booked time. Risk uses corrected economics and opening snapshots. Avoid summing lifecycle versions as new trades.
- **Currency and contract units:** qty is already in native energy units, not lots. GBP pence/therm NBP has factor 0.01; GBP/EUR are converted at the fixed 11 November close. No extra contract-hours multiplier is applied. Static instrument/listing data have 243 unique symbols, one primary listing each, and shares sum to one.
- Fees, rebates, order decisions/arrival benchmarks, rejects, queue position and anonymous exchange counterparties are absent. Consequently this review cannot calculate fee-net performance, full implementation shortfall, last-look rejection bias or prove who traded against exchange orders.
- Fixed session and audit variables preserve this review tomorrow; quote/fill/event retention is 3 months. Model and reference views use fixed @day/@asof overrides. Static commentary records today's findings even if source data are later restated.
